elements.element: No liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer (preferred)
elements.evidence: "paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A" — charges remain payable by Customer

elements.element: Early-termination fee is capped at 3 months' fees
elements.evidence: "Such early termination charges will not exceed 3 months' fees"

elements.element: That capped early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer
elements.evidence: "are the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer under this Agreement"

elements.element: Fee is payable by Customer in the early-termination context (party direction/trigger preserved)
elements.evidence: "Customer may terminate ... for convenience at the end of any calendar month by: b. paying the applicable early termination charges"

reasons: The single inserted sentence supplies both fallback atoms: a 3 months' fees ceiling on the Attachment A early-termination charges and an express statement that this is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
Preferred is not met because Customer still bears early-termination charges; the drafter's locked target was the fallback, so this is acceptable and sits at the fallback.

Minimality holds: no operative words were deleted or rewritten, the termination-for-convenience mechanic and the prerequisite Service Option Attachment carve-out remain intact, and no boilerplate or new exception was added.
No undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced; "fees" and "early termination charges" track the existing Attachment A construct.
